controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-zeek.connection-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-12T00:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp <= "2026-07-12T23:59:59.000Z"
  AND source.ip == "172.18.0.12" AND destination.ip == "172.18.0.5" AND destination.port == 22
| STATS count = COUNT(*), first_ts = MIN(@timestamp), last_ts = MAX(@timestamp),
        total_bytes = SUM(source.bytes + destination.bytes)
    BY source.ip, destination.ip, destination.port, network.community_id
| SORT count DESC
